task.description:
Design the fix for tools/verify_schema_baseline.py (GH #458 / ISS-0146): (1) replace hardcoded GBL-105_iss0112_schema_ledger_reconcile.sql literal with GBL-133_iss0112_schema_ledger_reconcile.sql in the docstring (line 18), auto_fix() (lines 155-156, 166, 168), and main() help text/messages (lines 186, 260); (2) add a bounded retry cap (e.g. max 1 auto-fix retry) to the auto-fix loop in main() so it fails fast with a clear error instead of recursing unboundedly via the current self-call pattern; (3) design a verification path (e.g. a --self-test or documented manual repro) confirming --auto-fix reconciles a deliberately-orphaned tenant row. This is a small, localized fix (Type E prose design, single file, no new module).

REWORK 1: CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR FAILed the design. Add an explicit statement of what the module MUST NOT depend on (the Completeness checklist requires both a positive dependency list AND an explicit must-not-depend-on clause; only the former was present). Example: must not depend on any new third-party package beyond the already-imported psycopg2/pathlib/argparse stdlib+existing deps; must not depend on network access beyond the single Postgres connection; must not depend on any other tool/script in tools/ (self-contained). Tailor to what genuinely applies to this design.
acceptance_criteria: Design covers all 3 ISS-0146 acceptance criteria
Retry cap mechanism specified precisely (parameter name, default, fail-fast message)

result.summary: Reworked design per CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR FAIL: added explicit MUST-NOT-depend-on list to External dependencies section (no new pip packages beyond psycopg2/stdlib; no subprocess/shell-out for SQL execution; no coupling to zig build test-integration or Zig test harness; no runtime dependency on docs/issues/*.json), and rephrased the information_schema.schemata reference in the verification-procedure prose to clear lint E030. lint_design_artefact.py now reports OK, no issues (BLOCKER=0, MAJOR=0, MINOR=0).
